name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: echo 'Acquire::Check-Valid-Until "false";' | sudo tee /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99ignore-valid-until > /dev/null; [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt-get install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
